sources.title: The Grapes of Wrath
sources.author: John Steinbeck
sources.excerpt: And then the dispossessed were drawn west - from Kansas, Oklahoma, Texas, New Mexico.
sources.longExcerpt: The dust had settled on everything. It was in the food, in the water, in the very air they breathed. And then the dispossessed were drawn west - from Kansas, Oklahoma, Texas, New Mexico; from Nevada and Arkansas, families, tribes, dusted out, tractored out. Carloads, caravans, homeless and hungry; twenty thousand and fifty thousand and a hundred thousand. They streamed over the mountains, hungry and restless - restless as ants, scurrying to find work to do - to lift, to push, to pull, to pick, to cut.
